title: I have seen love turning into hatred,
author: Ritu Mahipal / रितु महिपाल
text:
I have seen the moon hiding its face in the clouds of sorrows.

I have seen a flowing reflection even in happiness,
I have seen hiding the reflection in sorrow.

I have seen a paper boat smiling,
I have seen expensive toys crying too.

I have seen dreams being fulfilled in huts,
I have seen dreams being buried in palaces.

I have seen white drapes being colored in red colour,
I have seen colorful drapes transforming into whiteness.
